reviews.text: Great staff
We have trusted Memorial Cat Hospital with our cats' health for 25 years. They are cat specialists who love our cats as much as we do.
The staff and standard of care are wonderful!
A cat only hospital.  Awesome  no stinky  Dogs.  Lol. Cats rule!!! Dogs drool. The service is great
Thank you immensely for your 5-star rating!

I have never had a bad experience with any of the vets here and love how great they are with kitties (a lot of vets really aren't)! ROSES Rescues also brings our cats and kittens here whenever we are dealing with something weird or challenging. They are hands down the best experts to solve difficult problems and Dr. Folger especially is always available to give advice. They've helped with diabetes, mystery lumps, FIP, FeLV -- everything under the sun that ordinary vets might not know as much about!

Just cannot say enough great things about MCH, thank you for all the animals you've helped save!!!

We are so blessed to have this practice in Houston. The best and most knowledgeable cat vets in the country. They are dependable and compassionate. I am comfortable with them treating my fractious 22 year old diabetic cat. They can actually treat him without sedation a lot of the time. He’s a monster. That’s a huge deal at his age. Thank you!!

Dr. Folger is absolutely amazing! And if your cat isn’t orange, that’s okay — he will still love on them and take excellent care of them! 😂

The oranges are definitely his favorite, and he just kisses all over my baby. You can truly tell how much he cares about his patients and how dedicated he is to making them feel better. He takes the time to explain everything in a way that is very easy to understand and puts together a thoughtful treatment plan.

I highly recommend Dr. Folger to anyone looking for an exceptional feline veterinarian. Your cats will be in the very best hands! ❤️🐈

I am so happy to have moved my kitties care to Memorial Cat Hospital. The staff is very personable and caring. They LOVE cats. We saw Dr Folger, who built the practice up from nothing, and he was so interested in each kitty and did the most thorough exam I have ever seen done on my cats. We also boarded our two senior cats over holiday weekend. It was such a relief to know they were in wonderful care.

Exceptional place to take your beloved cat. All vetinary doctors are board certified in feline medicine! They're cat specialists! Everyone is very kind and accommodating. Dr. Folger is known nationally for his cat expertise and cat research.  Truly amazing place .
Great place, and attention to the cats is top-notch!
Dr. Rice and staff were kind and gentle with my cat and very patient in explaining possible conditions for which they are testing.
We ADORE Dr. Rice! And she didn’t even mind when Lucy got a little snoopy!
I just love the special care they show to my three cats. It makes a visit to the vet less stressful for my babies!
Awesome care of my kitty as usual.
Thanks for your positive feedback, Christi! We greatly appreciate your support.

I drive 30 minutes to have the privilege of having our feline family be cared for by memorial cat hospital.  Dr Addleman is the absolute best.  EVERYONE else is incredible too!!! They are smart and compassionate.  Thank you all.

I had such a great experience here! My cat can be very aggressive and difficult at the vet, and other clinics have turned her away or wouldn’t even attempt to do any exams because of her behavior. This vet was completely different. They were very patient with her. It is a relief to find a vet willing to work with her instead of immediately giving up. I’m so grateful for how they handled her and would definitely recommend them!
Great! Very efficient, caring, friendly! All of the veterinarians & staff are excellent with my precious cat.

Dr. Folger is great and the vet tech was AMAZING at handling my skittish disabled cat! He diagnosed her condition after giving her a thorough look and it was just such a relief after searching for answers from other clinics with no results.

we are so blessed to have Dr Folger and his team in our city. I've met some great feline vets but I don't think I've ever met anyone that excuded this level of pure love and commitment for cats, not to mention the medical authority he brings to the conversation.
We greatly appreciate your positive feedback. Thank you for choosing Memorial Cat Hospital.
My baby was very ill, so grateful for this team!

I wish Google would make an exception and let me give this place 10 stars. We took our 2 kitties to the clinic for the first time today, to obtain international travel pet certificates. The entire staff alongside Dr. Foglor were exceptional for their service, care, quality and friendliness of the staff. I would highly recommend this place to anyone with kitties.
Always professional and engaging.

We’ve been bringing our cat here for almost two years, driving 40 minutes each way because they supposedly specialize in cats. But after what happened last week, we are never going back. I honestly can't believe how unprofessional and irresponsible the staff was.

Our cat has been dealing with an eosinophilic plaque for over a month since the end of June, which is a painful, deep skin condition with heavy discharge. We followed the vet's treatment plan to the letter—never missed a single dose. During our first visit, the doctor told us that if it didn't improve, they would do a biopsy right there at Memorial Cat Hospital, since seeing a dermatology specialist was going to take over a month.

After 10 days with zero improvement, we called to get him rechecked. Knowing full well how terrible his condition was and how long the wait for a specialist is, the front desk and the doctor straight-up turned us away and canceled my recheck appointment. We ended up booking specialist appointments for late August and early September at Gulf Coast and Southwest (both more than a month out) and called Memorial Cat Hospital back just begging for a simple temporary bridge plan to keep our cat comfortable in the meantime. They never even bothered to call us back. It seems like they can only treat cats in perfect health and will take no responsibilities. Never again, thanks.
Efficient and compasionate personnel.  A very uplifting experience.

"Finding a vet you truly trust with your whole heart is rare, but Memorial Cat Hospital has been our sanctuary for over 12 years. Dr. Addleman has cared for three sets of our beloved cats, providing comforting, high-quality care through every stage of life—including the heartbreaking times our older ones crossed the rainbow bridge.
Having world-renowned veterinarians who specialize exclusively in feline medicine makes all the difference in the world. And when we travel, we have complete peace of mind boarding our cats with Susan. She treats every single baby like her own, and it touches our hearts that she still remembers and speaks fondly of our sweet Ally who passed long ago. Thank you, Dr. Addleman, Susan, and the entire staff, for loving our cats as much as we do." Lucy, Ally, Amori, Charlie, and Lola love you all!

The office staff, the technicians and the doctors are absolutely exceptional. Kind, helpful, and deeply in love with cats -— like my beautiful senior lady. Coco never relishes being loaded into her carrier, but as soon as her beloved Dr. Folger pets and talks to her, she calms right down. Highest possible recommendation, both mine and Coco's.
Great staff and Amazing Doctors ❤️❤️❤️
Dr. Rice was absolutely amazing - one of my cats was extremely freaked out and she was super gentle and kind with him.
I take all my 3 cats there, and I love it! Dr. Rice and all the staff are great! Highly recommend it.

Dr. Folger, Dr. Rice and their team did an amazing job on my son, Porters leg amputation. Because of their help and knowledge he is now cancer free! They made the experience and transition very smooth for Porter. He had the best care in their hands and we will be forever thankful for their hard work.

My cat & I felt very comfortable with everyone that we encountered at Memorial Cat Hospital. Dr.Tabitha Baibos was.just so wonderful and knowledgeable! She happily answered every question I had. Also, the vet techs were so kind & gentle with Elsa & that that really put her at ease. They know what they’re doing & I would highly recommend Memorial Cat Hospital. it’s a peaceful & happy place. Thank you.
Thank you for your 5-stars! We appreciate you choosing Memorial Cat Hospital.
We're ecstatic to hear about your positive experience at Memorial Cat Hospital. Thank you for your feedback!

I’ve been taking my fur babies to Memorial Cat Hospital for more than 10 years. The vets and their staff are knowledgeable, caring and it’s obvious they love what they do. Kudos to Dr. Addleman-Seder and Laura!

I was suppose to see Dr. Folgers.  They said that I called that morning, and that is why I did not see him.  I was very happy with the Vet that I did see, but they should not tell you that you are going to see one Vet and then give you another Vet when you get there.
The Dr. Rice  was amazing!! I’m a new cat momma and she was very informative!! Michaela was awesome!! She took incredible care of my fur baby and me!!

Monday, June 29, 2026, was my first visit to Memorial Cat Hospital.  If I could give more that 5 stars, I would!  The entire staff were amazing with my old cat, calming him through the exam and blood draw.  Sure, they introduced him to squeezy treats in the tube that I now think will have to be a regular purchase for me :-).
The lab results came in the following day and the Doctor called me herself with the results and clearly explained the next steps.
Memorial Cat Hospital has exceeded my expectations, which are, admittedly, oftentimes quite high.

Do NOT GO, EVER!! Like, EVER! 😤
Ok. Bit of a long one here, but as anyone knows by my reviews, I only give honest reviews whether good or bad.
So.
My wife and I took our cat in, because he had been excessively licking.. Turns out he had fleas, ok, so not a big issue. Until, they gave him medication. We brought him home, and then within a few hours, he was having an adverse reaction. We called up, they said to wash it off, so we did. He didn't get any better, so we went back and they washed it all off again. They then gave him Capstar and a steroid. Even though at first they recommended giving him the EXACT SAME medication that gave him an allergic reaction In the FIRST PLACE, the one THEY administered.
Over the next couple of days, he seemed lethargic and his appetite wasn't his usual. We called the vet, they said they would call back yet never did, so we took him in ourselves after work at about 5:40pm. They didn't want to do anything even though it was the medication THEY prescribed that was the issue.
Eventually they DID see him (after expecting us to leave when they gave a $960 estimate) but we weren't going anywhere until they rectified their mistake.
They did bloodwork, urinalysis , and while some of them were slightly elevated, they gave the all clear. The Vet said she was fine with all of the results and that he MIGHT have a UTI, and gave him an injection (two week antibiotic) and some painkillers. We noticed the day after the vet that he was sneezing. We monitored over the next few days, and its now Saturday (we were there Wed) and he has developed a wheeze, not constant, but it is there.
We called the Vet, to let them know we are coming in JUST so a tech could listen with a stethoscope. NO full exam, just wanted some peace of mind. Which one would expect after paying nearly $1000 two days previously. Not to mention the other $350 from the first visit (fleas) All the receptionist said was that they are closing in twenty minutes, and that we should go to an animal ER.
I explained again, that this is just a quick listen, since they are STILL OPEN for another twenty minutes, and we have already paid over $1300 this last week alone at their clinic. She said that they would have a quick look, see if they could squeeze him in for an appointment. I told her that it isn't an appointment, just a quick listen. She said ok.
THEN, my wife gets there, at 12:45pm (they are still open until 1pm) and instead of seeing him, they LOCKED THE DOOR, and turned off the lights. Putting im any extra effort is NOT what this clinic does, not unless they can empty your wallet as they do it, and even then, they are constantly watching the clock and reminding you "five minutes left, seven minutes left", etc.
So. Do NOT go here. They only care about the bottom line, and watching the clock, not the well-being of our animal, and most likely yours if you are reading this.
Honestly, they should be ashamed of themselves for this behavior.
Please for the sake of your pets, find someone that actually CARES about animals, not money.
We're overjoyed to hear about your positive experience at Memorial Cat Hospital. Thank you for sharing your feedback!
Friendly and caring explained procedures and results

MCH has been our vet through several seasons of life - and they are wonderful - compassionate, smart, wise, realists, and educators.  The staff is great - and very low turnover - so stable! I drive the extra distance for this group - and will continue to do so!
Dr Rice, Dr Addelman and the staff are all The Best! I love how they all work together and take such great care of my cats and me!

Dr Rachel Addleman-Seder is the most knowledgeable vetinarian I have ever seen!  After 4 years and 3 other vets seeing my cat she is the only one who has diagnosed her issues and did it within about 20 minutes of seeing her and then of course confirmed it with labs, an x-ray and sonogram.  I am very grateful!

2026:
Love Dr. Rice and the Tech team. They are so sweet to my baby and take good care of Flakey Poo. Thank you.

2024:
Great first visit for snowflake. The vet and tech were very informative and helpful.  This will be our long term vet.

Mary and I cannot recommend Memorial Cat Hospital highly enough. They have been our cats’ veterinarian for 20 years, caring for all of our cats with compassion, patience, and genuine dedication. For many years Mary and I had multiple cats, and in the last couple of years we were down to one, but through every stage they provided thoughtful, knowledgeable, and reassuring care. They always took the time to explain things clearly, answer our questions, and make each visit as calm and comfortable as possible.
Mary and I are especially grateful for the exceptional service and kindness they showed when one of our cats passed, and most recently when our last cat passed a month ago. Those moments are never easy, but the care and respect shown by Memorial Cat Hospital meant so much to us. Thank you to the entire staff for the compassion, professionalism, and support you have given us and our cats over the years. Mary and I will always remember Memorial Cat Hospital with gratitude and appreciation, and we are thankful for the 20 years of wonderful care they gave our cats.
Great experience!
We truly value your feedback. Thanks so much for sharing your experience with Memorial Cat Hospital!
Excellent care from technicians and vet. Our cat felt comfortable here.
We appreciate your 5-star rating. Thank you for your feedback.
Excellent service!  Clean, professional, attentive staff, received expert care, only recommended services that were needed. They deserve 5 Stars!  Thank-you!
Honestly never had a good experience at the vet, and I was definitely more nervous then my cat… but we both left happy 😊 …
They handled a very nervous cat very well! We love Dr. Folger and all his staff!
We appreciate your review and value your feedback.

This hospital came strongly recommended from a family member and I instantly could see why! Firstly, they somehow got my literal CHILD seen within an hour of calling them. They even gave me this amazing contraption for administering the oral meds - never in my life have I had such a useful luxury.
They completely put me at ease (I was hysterically worried about my cat who had s/o acute cystitis). Dr Baibos and her team were INCREDIBLE, I will absolutely be using this clinic going forward. Super affordable and amazing care!!! Don't hesitate to bring your beloved kitty in.
Mason  made a strong recovery, thank the goddess, and THANK YOU MEMORIAL CAT HOSPITAL!!!!!

Update. I've been coming here for over a year now with both of my babies. Continue to just adore this clinic and its incredible staff. The vet techs here are extraordinary. They provide such competent, compassionate and sensitive care. Both of my cats are increasingly comfortable coming to this clinic because of how well they know they will be treated here.

Special shout outs to Theresa and dr baibos. Theresa is hands down the most talented and experienced tech I've ever encountered, and Dr Baibos is also incredible. Vet care isn't cheap, but this clinic is comparatively reasonable, especially for the quality of care. Thanks for taking such good care of Mason and Isabella!

Our first experience here went great. I chose a cat specific vet after a horrible incident at a previous combo vet. The vet assistant and Veterinarian were great, they handled my babies with gentleness and care. Exam and shots were done in room, so we were able to witness what was being done to them. Exam was thorough and concerns were settled. It was all around a smooth experience.
Amazing team both the staff and the doctors!

The veterinarians and staff at Memorial Cat Hospital at knowledgeable, caring and love kitties. They keep up with new medical information and technology for felines. Have over 30 years of positive experiences with my cats.

Memorial Cat Hospital is simply the best. I know my cats will always receive exceptional care whenever I take them in. The entire hospital staff is caring, kind and professional.
The medical care our cats receive is top notch. And full of love and care for each of our cats.
It is always dependable. We always board our cats there when we travel and never have a worry!
The entire staff is always a blessing.

We took both cars in for their annual vaccines.  Already upset by the car ride to get there, we expected major issues trying to get them checked & vaccinated.  The exams went quickly and without them getting so upset they couldn't be vaccinated.  We were home in no time.
I was so impressed the way the tech and Dr. Addleman interacted with my cat. Dr. Adfleman asked questions and explained the diagnosis.  She seemed to really care which meant a lot to me.
Highly recommend Memorial Cat Hospital. Knowledgeable Doctors and technicians. Wonderful and nice front desk assistants. My kitty loves Dr. Addleman Seder. Thanks all you are the best!
They are terrific.  Knowledgeable and kind and savvy.  They take great care of cats and their owners.

It’s taken me a few weeks to write this because I’ve been very upset (not with them) unfortunately I had to put my very sick kitten down after a long fight with FIP. I found memorial cat hospital on the end of her life wishing I had known they were feline experts, prior. However they gave me the upmost care out of any of the 13 vets I had been to helping my kitty try to fight FIP. Unfortunately my little Beatrice’s time ended soon, however I cannot recommend them enough.

The day I put B down, the whole office knew it was coming and every single person who worked there was undeniably the kindest they could be to someone. I’ve never felt so much care and comfort during such a terrible time in my life. Even during and after the process the team kept coming to check on me knowing I was an absolute train wreck.

I recommend this office for everything and anything possible. I refer so many people here who are also extremely happy.

1000/10 recommend
Memorial Cat Hospital staff is fantastic!!! I have great confidence in the care my feline family recieves there!
The people here are so good and take such good care of my cats, it's amazing! I can't think them enough for all that they've done.

The entire staff and Vets are professional and compassionate. I appreciate their way to handle my experience of putting my beloved cat down.  They gave me all the space I need to grief and ensure me that it was the right decision for my cat.
They were super helpful and knowledgeable and urinary obstructions and took great care of my cat while he was there for 2 days.
It's the best place to take your cat; the doctors and nurses are very attentive and careful, always looking after the pets.

I took my 10 year old car to Memorial Cat Hospital after months of treatment for a "UTI" infection in 2 local "general" vet clinics. The difference in knowledge at Memorial Cat Hospital was noticeable and Dr Folger diagnosed the problem right away because of his vast knowledge with cats. They have the equipment, the expertise and attention that your cat deserves.

I Love Dr Addelmann Seder & Dr Folger.  Staff is good too. Vets show great concern when my babies are sick! They have 2 new vets which I have not had the pleasure to meet yet but I will.
Memorial Cat Hospital is expensive but their care is great… do be prepared when paying the bill.

Kindness beyond words
The compassion for the animals is remarkable the respect for their clients. It’s very noticeable and appreciated
WOW such a stress relief having a cat doctor that loves and understands cat behaviors
THE BEST ANIMAL CARETAKERS AND PEOPLE IN HOUSTON
Wonderful, friendly and compassionate staff.   They weee so kind to my fur baby and treated him like their own.

Clean !  Friendly !  Professional!
My cat felt comfortable and peaceful !  And I’m more than happy they discovered what my Uma had ! A simple allergy 😊 …
Great service
Dr. Addleman and her staff are amazing.  I would not trust my fur babies with anyone else.

Dr. Folger is extremely knowledgeable. He is board certified in Feline medicine. But what sets him apart is he GENUINELY CARES! I have been going to Memorial Cat Hospital for 10 years. Wouldn't take my babies anywhere else!
Memorial Cat Hospital is the best!  My cats and I have been going to Dr. Adelman for many years.  Their care and expertise is unmatchable.  Thank you so much for all you have done for my kitties.

I don't even know how to begin to express my appreciation and love for Dr. Rice and Memorial Cat Hospital. But I can say, I don't believe I'd still have my sweet boy, if it wasn't for their prompt, thorough, and compassionate care of Dale.
I wish I could see Dr. Folger. He explains everything so clearly. I love it when he looks at my Bengals and says "These guys are fine--they're just messin' with you."
Thank you for your five-star rating. We are honored to have provided excellent care for your feline companion.

My 15 year old cat needed a dental with extractions. She has chronic health issues, so I was worried about her going under, but they took such good care of her while under anesthesia. I don't think I would have trusted anyone else. I'm truly grateful to the team here that helped my baby feel better. They truly care about cats and know what they are doing. Thank you to Dr. Baibos, and Amy, and Theresa, and everyone else who helped her. Thank you to Memorial Cat Hospital in general. Frodo says thank you too!
Memorial Cat Hospital is truly the best! I wouldn’t take my kitties anywhere else. Henry, Lily, River, Thunder, Lightening and our newest kitty Storm would say the same (if they could talk).
All of the staff was very sweet with my kitty, and the vet was thorough and helpful with my qeuestions

Dr. Rice and the entire team at Memorial Cat Hospital have been conscientiously caring for our 18 1/2 year old kitty Sterling. He has many medical issues but has been managed carefully and lovingly and he even purrs when he sees all his “girlfriends” there!
We are overjoyed to hear about your positive experience at Memorial Cat Hospital. Thank you for 5 stars!
Expert care.
Thank you for the 5-star rating!

We first found Dr. Bill Folger and Dr. Jeanne Pittari at MCH in 1998, when we moved into the area. Since then, they and all the subsequent staff have provided our Feline Americans with brilliant, loving care. Tigger (The Mighty Jungle Cat), Prissy, Dharma, Rocky, Hobbes, Lance, Hermione, and our newest little love, Katy, all thrived in the care of Memorial Cat Hospital.
The vets there are amazing. They know more about cats than anywhere else!
Everyone was so friendly and helpful. They explained everything. So made recommendations since my little guy was a senior cat. We came up with plan to help him and hopefully prolong his life.
We're very happy we found this level of care for our cats, this close to home. The staff is knowledgeable, and extremely helpful and patient. We would definitely recommend them to anyone asking.
Thanks for your review. We appreciate your feedback.

Romeo, my cat, and I have been so pleased with this vet group. The front desk is always so nice and helpful. The vet techs are so good with Romeo and the vets are just great. My diabetic boy is only here 5 years later from when I got him because of Dr. Folgers medical advice. Thank you to the whole team!
Dr. FOLGER is excellent.   The entire staff is excellent

They had horrifying conditions 30 years ago, as I can see from the reviews, , it didn't change. Doctors without experience and they don't care. I was told one time from the receptionist, , they refuse me as a client, because I complained.
They did not have to worry.I never returned and had no intention to do so.
Thank you for your review. We appreciate your feedback.

They made an appointment possible same-day for us on short notice. They are always pleasant and professional with every visit, and take the time to not only examine and treat our cat, but to talk to us about the visit and any treatment and options that might be needed.

They have always been very thoughtful about the cat's health while balancing that with the cost of treatments, which is very much appreciated.

Not only do they know and treat cats, but they offer greater in-depth knowledge and treatment options than any other veterinarian practice I have been to for my cats. "
I just wish we'd found them sooner.

If you have a cat, especially one with any sort of potentially chronic or confusing health issues, this is the place.

The vet techs were kind and patient and allowed me to be in the room while my fur babies were getting examined and getting their blood drawn. Dr. Folger was gentle, knowledgeable and open to conversation about treatment options

We found a small cat that the shelters couldn’t take and memorial cat hospital made it possible with short notice to be able to get her vaccinated and ready for her new home in New York! We honestly couldn’t thank them enough for staying later to accommodate us! They were wonderful and would 10/10 recommend!
Always the best and my spoiled cat loves them!

I was super worried about switching to a new Vet. I kinda went in with a crazy cat mom attitude. But, the moment I met Dr Rice my nerves were calmed. Dr Rice has a lovely bedside manner. I was mainly concerned about 1 of my cats being able to receive a compounded medication. Dr Rice made certain she could get it for me before she started the exam.
All of the staff was kind and went above my expectations.
Thank you,
Crazy Cat Mom
The staff is prompt with phone calls and requests. My insurance company is picky with the vet notes. The office always provides it in a timely manner.

The cat specialists are very knowledgeable and the the front desk and tech staff are kind, helpful & knowledgeable.  They help calm me knowing my car is in good hands. Pricey but good. Come with or call with all your questions & they will respond quickly.

Dr Folger and all the staff are always amazing and helpful in times of need. ❤️

Another update. During a very difficult time when one of my cats had to be attended to by an emergency hospital. I was not very keen on what I was being advised to do for his after care, as he had a poor prognosis  Hearing my distress, one of the lovely receptionists Tara, along with the manager did everything they  could to squeeze me in to see Dr Folger as soon as my cat was discharged. Dr Folger is the most caring, honest cat lover and he took the time to discuss my cats case and was able to relieve me of the intense stress I was feeling not knowing what I was doing was the best for my cat Nikko. I cannot thank him enough, along with the techs that were so compassionate towards Nikko during his visit. He has always guided me in the right direction with both of my cats.I would recommend Memorial Cat Hospital to anyone with a furry feline, they are so caring, and will educate and guide you in what is truly the best  for your fur babies.❤️

Dr. Lowe is very compassionate and will assist you with the information needed to make the best health care decisions for your beloved pet. I am glad I found Memorial Cat Hospital! All the staff I have encountered ( front desk and Dr Lowe’s assistant)  have been very pleasant and helpful.
Best cat hospital in Houston very professional cat only vets. Wouldn’t take my cat anywhere else.

I have visited Memorial Cat Hospital twice within the year. I am beyond impressed with the dedication, affection, and knowledge shared by not only the Veterinarians, but the Staff, as well. My cat  has been treated like a King each time I called or visited with a concern. The matters are treated in a timely manner, and an answer is always provided. I am grateful that I chose for my sweet kitty to be a patient at Memorial Cat Hospital. We will remain dedicated because of YOUR dedication! Thank you, Memorial Cat Hospital! 🙏🏼🩷

Our cat was correctly diagnosed and given a treatment plan for her irritable bowl issue at this vet clinic vs the low cost vet who only used an X-ray and Not an Ultrasound like the Memorial Vet Hospital.  Yes, it’s is not cheap, but the quality of care is higher and they have 3 Vets and plenty of staff.  Worth the higher cost.

I followed Dr Addelman to your facility because she is a very compassionate knowledgeable vet who my cat twists and loves. She also cared for my older Doberman and was wonderful with her,
I am pleased that she is there to provide care to my Sr cat now he is older.
They always take great care of our kitties!
Always a pleasure to deal with this animal clinic.  Dr. Seder is so thorough and gives the best recommendations for my Ziggy Marley.  Thank you.
Extremely friendly and knowledgeable staff. Did not feel rushed. 10/10 recommend.

Had a Wonderful Experience at Memorial Cat Hospital. Couldn't ask for more....Blackie is in Rapid Recovery Mode.

Thank You Doctor and Staff
Very professional and caring experience for me and my cat.
Been a loyal customer since 2006.
I have been a client of Memorial Cat Hospital for more than 20 years and two cats.  Love the place.  I feel very confident of the care my cat receives.
As the name implies,  they are cat speclists.  Competent,  compassionate and kind. I recommend them.
Great service. Friendly staff. Knew a lot and explained it well.

Absolutely love this clinic! They’ve been nothing but helpful, quick to respond, and completely transparent about everything. Communication is always clear, and I never feel rushed or left in the dark. I truly trust them with my cat’s care, and it’s such a relief knowing my cat's in such good hands.

We absolutely loved the attention, service, care and expertise by the entire staff. Thank you Dr. Folger. Frankie looks more animated already. We are very sorry that we did not thank the vet technician. We felt terrible that she did so much work and we didn’t say thank you. Please let her know that we appreciate her very much. Bambi
We're pleased to hear about your positive experience at Memorial Cat Hospital. Thank you for your feedback.

Came for annual check up for my cat and annual rabies vaccine. I have been coming here for ages. Everyone is so friendly and really cares about the health of every cat I’ve brought in. Every doctor here is amazing, but for me personally, I’ve entrusted my cats with Dr. Folger and have never looked back.

We just moved and needed a new vet for our fur babies.  Just took the first one this past weekend and had a great experience.  My girl was treated so well and felt very comfortable with the staff.  So happy we have an awesome place to take our fur babies knowing they will receive awesome care.
Super service.  Worked my cat in on a busy day and worked only to help with the problem.

In 2018, Dr Folger saved my cat’s life by nursing him back from the brink of death and helped him get placed in a rescue. I adopted him that year, and he’s now living a happy and healthy life. When we visited yesterday, Dr Folger remembered him and we had a lovely time getting him his check up.

Dr Folger cares deeply about cats, and it’s evident from how he interacts with them and their owners. Couldn’t ask for a better vet!
Thank you for sharing your positive experience with us Nicki.

Today was my first visit, Memorial Cat Hospital offered a level of care that touched my heart.💜 They cared for my cat with gentleness, gave me clear guidance, and treated us both with dignity and warmth.🦁🐾 The clinic is spotless and peaceful. 🌱May God bless them for their compassion.🙏🏻

"Let all that you do be done in love."
1 Corinthians 16:14
🙌🏻
Every one there, just every single one, will shower you and your pet with love 💞
The entire staff treats you and your cat like rock stars. Dr Rice is great!
A little expensive, but very good care.

AVOID THIS PLACE — Shocking lack of hygiene, care, and professionalism

I had a confirmed appointment at 12:00 PM and drove nearly an hour to get there. No one acknowledged me, gave an update, or even made eye contact for 45+ minutes. Only after I asked several times did they vaguely say there were “emergencies” and they didn’t know if we’d be seen at all — despite our scheduled visit.

Meanwhile, the clinic was filthy: stained chairs, dirty floors, and grimy counters. It felt less like a vet clinic and more like a forgotten storage room.

The front desk staff? Cold, dismissive, and condescending. My cat, who suffers from anxiety, sat trembling in her carrier — not a single person cared enough to ask or check.

I left without being seen.

There is no excuse for how poorly this clinic handles both pets and people. I genuinely don’t understand the positive reviews — something doesn’t add up.
Do NOT risk your pet’s health or your peace of mind here.

We drove 30 minutes to this clinic for my cat’s annual check-up, trusting the online reviews — unfortunately, it was a very disappointing experience.

The staff was cold and unwelcoming when we arrived. Even though we had an appointment, we were taken into a room and left waiting for 40 minutes with no communication whatsoever. No one explained what was going on until we asked. Only then were we told there were “a few emergency cases,” but they couldn’t tell us when (or if) the doctor would be available. The response we got was simply, “We don’t know,” which is unacceptable and unprofessional.

We ended up leaving before the doctor even came, because waiting in a stressful, uncertain environment for hours is not something we were willing to put our cat through.

The exam room itself was also unclean and not sterile — cat hair everywhere, very poorly maintained. No one apologized or even acknowledged the inconvenience when we left.

This level of disorganization and lack of basic courtesy is inexcusable. Definitely not going back, and I wouldn’t recommend this place to anyone.
